data.narrative:
Kvertus is a Growth-stage defense and security company founded by Yaroslav Filimonov and Andrii Znaichenko, currently raising on approximately $130M in total capital raised. The target operates within a Defense & Security sector peer set comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-to-next-stage advancement. Using the $130M total raised as a baseline proxy, this method implies a valuation of $156M. A peer-median approach was not applicable: while 22 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) yielded fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide medians insufficiently reliable without introducing material bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $133M (low) to $179M (high), centered on a median of $156M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the limited comparability of the private peer set (heterogeneous subsectors within Defense & Security) and the absence of sufficient same-stage, same-tier comps to triangulate via market multiples. The reliance on a single quantitative method introduces model risk; validation would benefit from expanded peer data or disclosed revenue/growth metrics from the target.
